body:
I have some updated information for this bug, as well as an MRP.

[self-point-error-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20061993/self-point-error-test.zip)

The bug happens due to typed Dictionary usage, during serialisation of data.

To the best of my very limited c++ abilities, I was able to narrow down the problem to 3 functions: `Array Dictionary::values() const` and `const Variant *Dictionary::getptr(const Variant &p_key) const` and `void EditorPropertyDictionary::update_property()`. In my testing, if I disabled the type-aware logic in these functions, behaviour would be as expected. (I am too tired and unfamiliar with this project to properly debug any further)

In addition to the symptoms OP listed, the values of the Dictionary will appear as null in the debugger.
